chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Near Boston, 1999. The World Cup semi-final: China against Norway. Liu Ailing’s long pass finds Jin Yan. Saved... but Sun Wen scores!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. The defenders all watch Jin Yan’s shot. Sun Wen waits in the space behind them, where nobody is looking.

chapters.label: Trap, turn, shoot
chapters.text: The keeper saves, and the ball bounces out to Sun. She traps it, turns hard, and scores with her left foot! Only three minutes gone!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: find space where the defenders are not looking. When the ball comes to you, finish quickly!
